title: OlmPool: AI2 Long-Context Architectural Study
summary: A suite of 26 7B open-source models released by Allen AI to investigate how architectural choices like QK normalization and sliding window attention drive long-context performance. It isolates specific 'catastrophic' combinations that degrade context extension by nearly 50% despite identical training data.
research_notes: The suite required 170,000 H100 hours and includes 38 checkpoints for each of the 26 models to analyze at what point long-context capability 'cracks'.

evolution.summary: Released in April 2026, the study findings are currently informing the development of next-generation architectures like OLMo 4 and the OMAI cluster upgrades announced in May 2026.
